stories.name: stories
stories.raw_code:
source: stories is orca.table('stories') extend {
  primary_key: story_id

  # label="Story Count"
  # number="#,##0"
  measure: story_count is count()
  # label="Unique Authors"
  # number="#,##0"
  measure: unique_author_count is count(author)
  # label="Total Score"
  # number="#,##0"
  measure: total_score is sum(score)
  # label="Average Score"
  # number="0.0"
  measure: avg_score is avg(score)
  # label="Max Score"
  # number="#,##0"
  measure: max_score is max(score)
  # label="Total Comments"
  # number="#,##0"
  measure: total_comments is sum(comment_count)
  # label="Average Comments per Story"
  # number="0.0"
  measure: avg_comments is avg(comment_count)
  # label="Link Story Count"
  # number="#,##0"
  measure: link_story_count is count() { where: url is not null }
  # label="Show/Ask HN Count"
  # number="#,##0"
  measure: show_ask_count is count() { where: title ~ 'Show HN:%' or title ~ 'Ask HN:%' }
}

comments_base.name: comments_base

comments.name: comments
comments.raw_code:
source: comments is comments_base extend {
  join_one: parent_story is stories on story_id = parent_story.story_id
  join_one: parent_comment is comments_base on parent_id = parent_comment.comment_id

  # label="Comment Count"
  # number="#,##0"
  measure: comment_count is count()
  # label="Unique Authors"
  # number="#,##0"
  measure: unique_author_count is count(author)
}

top_stories.name: top_stories
top_stories.raw_code:
query: top_stories is stories -> {
  group_by: title, author, created_at
  aggregate: 
    score is sum(score)
    comments is sum(comment_count)
  order_by: score desc
  limit: 10
}

check_valid_stories.name: check_valid_stories
check_valid_stories.description: Verify story_id primary keys are non-null
